description: This file defines interfaces for grain storage operations in Orleans, including methods for reading, writing, and clearing state, with support for concurrency control via ETag and cancellation tokens.

classes.name: IStorage
classes.description: Interface for operating on grain storage, providing methods for state management with concurrency and cancellation support.

classes.name: IStorage<TState>
classes.description: Generic interface extending IStorage, adding a property for the grain state.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the grain state with cancellation support.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the grain state with cancellation support.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state with cancellation support.
